summary: sk_stream_wait_connect() reads socket state/error in sk_wait_event while tcp_disconnect()/shutdown can change the same sock fields concurrently.

call_chain.evidence: locked send path waits for connect
waits for connection state using sk_wait_event

bug_site.code: writes sk->sk_state during disconnect/reset state transition

interleaving: A sendmsg task waits in sk_stream_wait_connect(), whose sk_wait_event condition is evaluated locklessly first.
A shutdown/disconnect task changes sk_state/sk_err on the same struct sock.
The fix wraps lockless condition reads with READ_ONCE across stream, SMC, LLC, TIPC, TLS, and BPF wait sites.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: Lockless sk_wait_event condition checks must READ_ONCE socket state/error fields because peer syscall paths can update them concurrently.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: The reported changed value and patched wait condition center on sk_state; related sk_err/sk_shutdown/sk_write_pending condition fields are sibling surfaces patched for the same macro pattern.

aliases.name: sk
aliases.evidence: send path passes the TCP struct sock to the wait helper

aliases.name: sk
aliases.evidence: disconnect operates on the same struct sock

aliases.name: sk->sk_err/sk_shutdown
aliases.evidence: sibling wait conditions patched with READ_ONCE

published_by: inet socket ops expose the same sock to sendmsg/shutdown/disconnect syscalls

coverage.analysis_conclusion: stream.c contains the reported wait reader; net/ipv4/tcp.c is required for tcp_sendmsg/tcp_disconnect and was added; the other patched files contain sibling sk_wait_event condition surfaces in the same fix.

patch_hunks: stream.c wraps sk_err/sk_state/sk_shutdown reads in READ_ONCE; sibling wait sites in tcp_bpf, llc, smc, tipc, and tls receive analogous annotations.
indirect_edges: TCP protocol ops dispatch sendmsg to tcp_sendmsg and disconnect/shutdown to TCP disconnect path; sk_wait_event first evaluates conditions locklessly.
entry_discovery_log: After repair, merged.ll contains sk_stream_wait_connect, tcp_sendmsg, tcp_sendmsg_locked, and tcp_disconnect.
repair_commands: created temporary worktree at fix_commit^ and compiled net/ipv4/tcp.c with clang-15 to tcp.ll
linked tls_main.ll socket.ll smc_tx.ll smc_rx.ll smc_close.ll af_llc.ll tcp_bpf.ll stream.ll tcp.ll into merged.ll with external llvm-link
notes: llvm-link emitted only a target-triple warning for tcp.ll; merged.ll was produced and contains required definitions.
